verdict.rationale: Drata's own docs show it ships a hosted trust center: SafeBase Trust Center branding and URL setup, a Trust Center analytics dashboard, and programmatic trust-center management alongside questionnaire automation for faster security reviews. The evidence is mostly article titles, though, and none of it confirms live control status, certification and report sharing, or click-through NDA gating. Missing for 10: live control-status display, documented certification/report sharing, click-through NDA access gating, in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
